note: Every public source found for com.facebook.katana, com.facebook.orca and com.facebook.lite, with the branches and commits it was last read at, its licence and what Hushfacebook may take from it. scripts/facebook-sources.ps1 holds it to its rules, scripts/audit-facebook-sources.ps1 refreshes it, and a local release needs a census from the last 14 days. docs/sources.md is the readable version.

entries.reason: The maintained Facebook source and Hushfacebook's primary upstream. Its anchors hold across Facebook's renames, its patches fail loudly at patch time, and most of the shipped patches were rewritten from its commit 5db2e57e. The bundle also patches LINE, so only its Facebook, shared and extension code is watched. The 2026-11-12 review found main and dev moved to ea1cae9f, which adds an Andrew's Patch Setting screen for its Facebook switches and turns its AMOLED theme, three Stories and Reels patches and Save as H.264 on by default. Nothing new was ported, and the adopted commit stays 5db2e57e.

entries.reason: Its dev branch (v1.5.0-dev.4, 2026-09-28) replaced the old ReVanced Facebook pair with 15 named Facebook patches across 17 source files for 580.0.0.51.74, built on runtime method search and hooking rather than fingerprints, plus the same eight GPL-3.0 Messenger patches from main, still pinned to 573.0.0.44.88. A base for the Messenger sibling and for what Hushfacebook doesn't have yet: analytics blocking beyond ads, picture-in-picture and performance trims. entries.reason: The largest GPL-3.0 Messenger set, inside a 278-patch multi-app bundle. Screen capture in encrypted chats and the screenshot-detection bypass change what other people are told, so they would not ship by default. The watched shared Constants.kt carries the declared Messenger compatibility. The 2026-10-02 review found the Messenger tree unchanged but compatibility constants changed from the old pin; Lenart12 adds BlockBlast work while retaining the same Messenger tree. The 2026-10-18 review found the main and dev commits moved with compatibility-constant changes only. The three automated tracker branches pin the same Messenger tree with updated verified versions, so they add no new Messenger behavior. Jman's registry and the Morphe directory also list its bundle under Facebook because of an August 2026 release that added a Facebook patch set. The current patch list names Messenger only, so no Facebook patch is recorded. The 2026-11-12 review found main at c7e5a560 and dev at facc027e, both changing only Constants.kt (verified versions, their sorting and two new app entries), with the Messenger tree unchanged. Two more tracker branches change the same file only, and three dependabot branches carry dev's Messenger tree, so none adds Messenger behavior.

The watched app/src/main tree at 6a22e0e matches the reviewed repository head f2bc97330ddeea38139379130ebb9c38ea0c4c3d. Its licence permits consideration, but no code has been ported or adopted. On 2026-10-18 main added Facebook 583 hook classes next to the 582 ones, a current-video download row and Threads video filtering. The 2026-11-12 review found main's watched tree at 6fe3d675 with Facebook 584, 585 and 586 support, a Messenger module (Meta AI button hiding, privacy controls with a local read state, message status icons and Messenger 586 including its rebuild 347215343), separate Facebook and Messenger settings tabs, a true color range video toggle, and host restart and Meta AI controls. entries.reason: GPL-3.0 at the repository level, but its Facebook master patch says it ports every FacebookAppAdsRemover hook, and that code has no licence. The Facebook subtree is behavior-only until Loukious licenses it. The feature list retains the reviewed branch union. On 2026-10-02 the fix/tiktok-split-apk branches diverged from the removed sync-and-fix branch and changed FacebookAdHelpers.kt and ad/Fingerprints.kt. Reels shopping hooks remained on root/nonroot but were absent from those other branches. On 2026-10-04 root moved Facebook onto a class-loader dex source behind a multidex gate, with the CSR sponsored slot queue, an ad-free session spoof, unseen story viewing, l.php unwrapping and screenshot allowing. The 2026-10-12 review found only root and a restored nonroot branch. Both new pins retain the same watched Facebook tree and KatanaDexGate blob as the recorded 9a90bbbd010fa5e567ae3e5c0c164964f32eb14d pin, so they establish no new Facebook behavior. The 2026-10-18 review found the nonroot branch deleted. Root moved to e9a69de0 with the Facebook tree split into ad, download and link packages (media download for photos, videos, reels and stories, and an open-links-in-browser patch), and the refactor-ig and runcatching branches are new pins. The unlicensed Loukious ad hooks are still ported inside, so the Facebook subtree stays behavior-only. The 2026-11-12 review found the repository renamed from NexAlloy-XES to SexAlloy, with archive-2026-10-25-zalo-download as its default branch. refactor-ig and runcatching are gone. root, nonroot (back again) and jadx-dexkit-harness share Facebook work at b4188d99, which adds affiliate link hiding, active status hiding, exact post times, comment GIF downloads and a game bridge wrapper beside the ad patches. The archive branch's Facebook work stops at bdc4c2a7, before the exact-time and GIF files. The tree also holds files named after Hushfacebook patches (HoldAnalyticsUploadsPatch, UploadStoriesInHdPatch, SanitizeShareLinksPatch, HideCommentTypingPatch), already there at e9a69de0. HideFacebookAdsPatch.kt is still in the tree, so the contamination and the behavior-only restriction stand.

It is still a port of this bundle, so it stays rejected.

entries.reason: Recorded on 2026-11-12. This is the copy of ToThangGTVT/morphe-fb-lite that the ledger held as a mirror, renamed from BlazeFTL/morphe-fb-lite (repository id 1403457688, created 2026-10-03, not a GitHub fork). It still carries ToThangGTVT's d69c0d69 but has gone its own way since: font patch updates, Facebook Lite 536.0.0.11.107 support (2026-11-08), CI commits and release v1.6.6, now twelve declared patches. patches-list.json is left out of the watch paths because every CI release commit rewrites it. It is a GPL-3.0 Lite candidate with the original's caveats: distinct derivative branding, and the origin of its native stubs and its fit with Hushfacebook Lite need independent proof. Later on 2026-11-12 main and dev took the Arabic branch (d7e8154f, release v1.6.6), which then went away. It moves the overlay buttons for right-to-left layouts and adds Arabic words to the name filter in its extension, with the same twelve patches. Nothing is adopted.
